integrity: Two included standalone Python 3 programs reproduced the stated finite checks. General claims rely on written proofs; independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Transitive subgroups and full Young products with factor size at least two are covered; arbitrary intransitive subgroups and homotopy fixed points are not. The older proper partition-poset full text was not accessible; a differently formulated antecedent remains possible.
title: Fixed spaces of partial-partition complexes under transitive and Young symmetries
